subject.title: fix(ui): add timeout to control-ui bootstrap config fetch

question: Should the Control UI permanently treat a bootstrap response taking more than 15 seconds as unavailable and continue without its server-provided metadata?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but repository evidence does not define the acceptable deadline or prove that silently dropping delayed routing and authentication metadata is compatible with supported deployments.

options.title: Confirm the bounded fallback
options.body: Adopt the 15-second fail-open contract after the contributor adds actual-app before/after diagnostics showing the user-visible improvement and preserved slow-success behavior.

options.title: Align with a shared lifecycle budget
options.body: Replace the standalone cutoff with an owner-selected bootstrap or handshake deadline and compose it with any caller-provided cancellation signal.

options.title: Decline the hardening
options.body: Close the PR if the background request has no material user-visible impact and a fixed metadata cutoff is not worth the compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Confirm the bounded fallback
recommendation.body: Adopt the 15-second fail-open contract after the contributor adds actual-app before/after diagnostics showing the user-visible improvement and preserved slow-success behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev introduced the current dashboard-v2 application architecture and has the strongest history-based connection to its bootstrap behavior.
